message: Stop — mains voltage can kill. Do not breadboard mains or open supplies. Get an experienced adult or professional to supervise; use only an enclosed, fused module.
Stop. A puffy or hot lithium pack can catch fire — unplug it, move it to a non-flammable surface, and get an experienced adult. Never puncture it or charge it unattended.
Burning smell or hot parts = power off now, check for shorts (continuity beep between VCC and GND) before repowering.
Reverse polarity kills boards fast. Power off, verify +/− with multimeter, add a series diode next time for protection.
